map.评估意识障碍程度，总分 3-15 分，分数越低意识障碍越重。: Assesses the degree of impaired consciousness, total 3-15 points, the lower the score the more severe the impairment.
map.GCS = E + V + M，范围 3-15 分。≤8 分提示重度昏迷，需立即: GCS = E + V + M, range 3-15 points. A score ≤8 indicates severe coma and requires immediate airway protection.
map.ASA 美国麻醉医师协会分级: ASA American Society of Anesthesiologists Physical Status
map.评估麻醉手术风险，共 6 级（Ⅰ-Ⅵ），附加 E 表示急诊。: Assesses the anaesthetic surgical risk, 6 levels in total (I-VI), with E appended for emergency cases.
map.Ⅲ 级 - 严重系统疾病（功能受限）: Grade III - Severe systemic disease (functional limitation)
map.Ⅳ 级 - 严重系统疾病危及生命: Grade IV - Severe systemic disease that is a constant threat to life
map.Ⅴ 级 - 濒死，不论手术与否: Grade V - Moribund, whether or not surgery is planned
map.Ⅵ 级 - 脑死亡器官捐献: Grade VI - Brain death, organ donation
map.ASA 分级越高，围术期并发症和死亡率越高。Ⅲ 级及以上需术前多学科评估。: The higher the ASA grade, the higher the perioperative complication and mortality rates. Grade III and above require multidisciplinary assessment before surgery.
map.评估非瓣膜性房颤患者卒中风险，指导抗凝治疗。: Assesses stroke risk in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation and guides anticoagulation therapy.
map.男性 ≥2 分或女性 ≥3 分建议抗凝；评分越高年卒中风险越高。: Anticoagulation is recommended for men scoring ≥2 or women scoring ≥3; the higher the score, the higher the annual stroke risk.
map.评估社区获得性肺炎严重程度，决定治疗场所。: Assesses the severity of community-acquired pneumonia and determines the treatment setting.
map.0-1 分门诊；2 分住院；3 分及以上需 ICU 评估。: 0-1 points outpatient; 2 points hospital admission; 3 points or above needs ICU assessment.
map.评估终末期肝病严重程度，用于肝移植优先级排序。: Assesses the severity of end-stage liver disease and is used for liver transplant prioritisation.
map.MELD-Na 公式纳入血钠校正。评分 ≥15 分通常推荐肝移植评估。: The MELD-Na formula incorporates sodium correction. A score ≥15 usually warrants transplant evaluation.

map.急诊/ICU 用 GCS 评估意识水平（E+V+M），用 CURB-65 判断社: In emergency and ICU settings use GCS to assess the level of consciousness (E+V+M), and CURB-65 to judge community-acquired pneumonia severity and whether admission is needed.
map.术前用 ASA 分级估计围术期风险，用 CHA₂DS₂-VASc 评估非瓣膜性房: Before surgery use the ASA grade to estimate perioperative risk, and CHA₂DS₂-VASc to assess stroke risk and anticoagulation indications in non-valvular atrial fibrillation.
map.肝病随访用 MELD / MELD-Na 评估终末期肝病严重程度与移植优先级。: For liver disease follow-up use MELD / MELD-Na to assess end-stage liver disease severity and transplant priority.
map.①GCS = 睁眼 E(1-4) + 语言 V(1-5) + 运动 M(1-6): ①GCS = eye opening E(1-4) + verbal V(1-5) + motor M(1-6), total 3-15; ≥13 mild, 9-12 moderate, ≤8 severe coma (needs airway protection and emergency imaging). ②ASA I-VI, perioperative mortality reference <1% / 1-5% / 5-10% / 10-50% / >50%, with emergency surgery (E) further increasing risk. ③CHA₂DS₂-VASc: heart failure 1, hypertension 1, age ≥75 counts 2, diabetes 1, stroke/TIA counts 2, vascular disease 1, age 65-74 counts 1, female 1; 0 points low risk (usually no anticoagulation), 1 point moderate risk, ≥2 points high risk (anticoagulation recommended, warfarin target INR 2-3). ④CURB-65: impaired consciousness, urea >7 mmol/L, respiratory rate ≥30/min, hypotension (systolic <90 or diastolic ≤60), age ≥65, 1 point each; 0-1 points outpatient (30-day mortality about 1.5%/3.2%), 2 points admission (3.9%), ≥3 points high risk (17%/40%/57%). ⑤MELD see the worked example below.
map.算例与 MELD 口径说明: Worked example and notes on MELD
map.GCS 默认 E4+V5+M6 = 15，判轻度意识障碍。CHA₂DS₂-VAS: GCS default E4+V5+M6 = 15, judged as mild impairment of consciousness. CHA₂DS₂-VASc heart failure + hypertension + age ≥75 = 1+1+2 = 4 points, high risk, oral anticoagulation is recommended. CURB-65 with 3 items selected = 3 points, judged high risk (30-day mortality about 17%), requires admission and ICU evaluation. MELD needs care: this tool implements 0.957·ln(bilirubin) + 0.378·ln(creatinine) + 1.120·ln(INR) + 0.643, whose coefficients are about 1/10 of the textbook formula and with the bilirubin and creatinine coefficients swapped, and the result is clamped at the lower bound 6 — with bilirubin 2.0 mg/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, INR 1.2 and Na 140 mmol/L the tool gives MELD-Na = 6, while standard MELD = 3.78·ln(bilirubin) + 11.2·ln(INR) + 9.57·ln(creatinine) + 6.43 = 11.1; another set (bilirubin 5.0, creatinine 2.0, INR 1.8, Na 130) gives 15 from the tool versus 25.7 for the standard value. For clinical and transplant assessment follow the standard formula or the hospital/UNOS system; this tool's results serve only as a trend demonstration.
map.GCS 8 分为什么是气管插管的常用界线？: Why is a GCS of 8 the usual threshold for endotracheal intubation?
map.GCS ≤8 分时咽喉反射显著减弱、误吸与气道梗阻风险急剧升高，难以维持有效通气: At GCS ≤8 the pharyngeal reflex is markedly weakened and the risk of aspiration and airway obstruction rises sharply, making effective ventilation hard to maintain, so most guidelines take GCS ≤8 as the indication for airway protection by intubation. This is an empirical threshold though, and it must still be judged together with respiratory rhythm, oxygenation, the presence of airway injury, sedation and neuromuscular blockade; the score alone can mislead (for example in alcohol intoxication or after sedation the score is artificially low).
map.CHA₂DS₂-VASc 1 分时要不要抗凝？: Should anticoagulation be given when CHA₂DS₂-VASc is 1?
map.要看这 1 分来自哪一项。若仅因「女性」得 1 分（即无其他危险因素），属真正的: It depends on which item the 1 point comes from. If it is only because of "female" (no other risk factors), it is genuinely low risk and anticoagulation is usually not needed; if it comes from a substantive risk factor such as hypertension, diabetes or heart failure, men may consider anticoagulation and women are more inclined to be recommended it. The guidelines also stress weighing bleeding risk (such as the HAS-BLED score), with the final decision made by the physician together with the patient's wishes.
